jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(6)(A) inventory: Twinfield Union School District, a union school district in the Caledonia Central Supervisory Union (member towns: Marshfield, Plainfield), formed 1967. Operates PK-12.
Twinfield Union School / Caledonia Central SU (official site).

sources.note: Twinfield Articles of Agreement (1967), codified at 16 V.S.A. App. ch. 95(b): each member district is entitled to one director plus one per 100 enrolled students (or major fraction) -- currently 3 Marshfield + 3 Plainfield on every recent official roster. The district's School Board Members page (twinfield.ccsuvt.net, fetched 2026-10-22) publishes the current board with towns and expirations: Barry (M) 2027, Baer (M) 2028, Bezak (M) 2029, Osman (P) 2028, Padilla (P) 2027, Andrews (P) 2029. FLAG (Padilla): the Plainfield seat expiring 2027 was Milena Yasus's in the 2022 annual report (her term there expiring 2024, consistent with a March 2024 election for the 2027 class); how Padilla took the seat (2024 election vs. appointment and later election) is documented in no fetched source -- she is minted ELECTED off the current official roster holding an unexpired term, with the succession flagged. Resolving documents: the board's 2024-2026 minutes and the March 2026 warning/results.

directors.name: Kendra Padilla
directors.note: Succession to the Yasus seat undocumented -- see the flag in the board sources.
